description: Unit tests for NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager in the net:: namespace, focusing on preferences read/write, network change simulation, and clearing preferences.

classes.name: TestPrefDelegate
classes.description: A test implementation of NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager::PrefDelegate that tracks read/write counts and stores a dictionary value.

methods.name: TestPrefDelegate::SetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Sets the dictionary value and increments write count.

methods.name: TestPrefDelegate::GetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current dictionary value and increments read count.

methods.name: TestPrefDelegate::write_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times the prefs were written.

methods.name: TestPrefDelegate::read_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times the prefs were read.
